text:
Mia: Quick async check — dedicated capacity onboarding. Can owners confirm cluster readiness & reservation IDs? Timeline: we need 12 GPUs available for perf test next Tue. Who owns reservation in DB vs infra config? @Alex @Devon

Alex: We have 2 racks physically staged at colo. Vendor ETA Wed AM, serials attached to procurement ticket #4521. Rack install should be done next day. I'm owning physical install. Reservation currently created but not bound to cluster: `resv-rt-89a7`.

Devon: I'm owning infra config + cluster bootstrap. PR #1284 is pending review — it adds reservation mapping and IAM roles. CI is failing on kubelet certs right now. Pinging @Jordan for SRE creds approval.

Jordan: I can unblock certs today. I'll rotate the ACME certs for the test cluster and add the nodepool role. Planning load test on Friday. Note: staging only has nv4x2 nodes atm — are those ok for perf test?

Mia: Perf test needs H100-like throughput; nv4 won't cut it. Need at least 8 A100/H100-equivalent GPUs per test shard. Can procurement confirm exact SKUs? @Alex

Alex: Vendor confirmed H100 units, we ordered the H100-80GB SKU under the +q pricing tier. Rack name is `dedi-us-west-2a-r2`. ETA to colo updated to 2026-01-07. I'll post tracking numbers once I have them.

build-bot: Deploy job started: `cluster-bootstrap` (job #3421) — https://ci.redwood/3421. Logs streaming.

Devon: After PR merge, run the bind and apply steps locally then trigger the migration:
```
# bind reservation to cluster
redwood-reserve bind --id resv-rt-89a7 --cluster dedi-us-west-2a-r2
kubectl apply -f overlays/dedi/cluster-config.yaml
```
Also apply DB migration `migrations/20260102_bind_resv.sql` (one-time).

Alex: Procurement FYI — customs delays possible for this shipment; we prebooked alternate capacity in us-west-2b (reservation `resv-rt-89b2`). Can infra support automatic fallback if the primary rack is delayed?

Devon: Yes, smart-routing supports fallback across dedicated pools. We'll need the feature flag `fallback-dedicated` enabled in prod and the mapping for both reservations present. PR #1290 will expose the flag. Need CS/Platform approval to flip it.

Jordan: For perf windows: earmarking 2026-01-09 08:00 UTC for burn-in and 2026-01-16 for full perf. I'll create tickets for canary traffic, fixed load shader, and alerting thresholds (p99 latency, token/sec).

Mia: Quick ownership recap: Alex -> hardware/procurement/tracking; Devon -> infra config, PRs, reservation binding; Jordan -> certs, SRE burn-in, alerts. Next milestone: "reservation bound" by 2026-01-06. If anyone is blocked, escalate to @Mia.

Devon: One small question — who will add the infra team ACL to the colo portal? We need the `infra-colo-ops` IAM group added so bootstrap can fetch secrets.

Alex: I'll add `infra-colo-ops` to the colo portal by EOD today.

Mia: Great — thanks all. If you hit blockers paste logs here or @mention me. :thumbsup:
